title: FloodGuard Claim-Free Renewal Credit
content:
The FloodGuard Private Flood Policy grants a claim-free credit on the renewal term premium, read from the flood claim payments issued on the policy.

## Clause

A claim-free credit reduces the renewal term premium by 4 percent when no flood claim payment has ever been issued on the policy; by 2 percent when a flood claim payment was issued on the policy but none within the 60 months before the date the renewal is recorded; and by nothing when a flood claim payment was issued within those 60 months.

## Schedule

| Flood claim payments issued on the policy | Credit |
|---|---|
| None, ever | 4 percent |
| At least one, the most recent more than 60 months before the renewal is recorded | 2 percent |
| At least one within the 60 months before the renewal is recorded | No credit |

## Either side of the 60 months (hypothetical)

- Most recent flood claim payment issued 61 months before the renewal is recorded: 2 percent.
- Most recent flood claim payment issued 59 months before the renewal is recorded: no credit.
- A policy that has had a claim reported but no payment ever issued on it: 4 percent, since the credit turns on payments issued.
